scope.population: 7 hand-built join fixtures, not market data
scope.window: n/a: the fixtures carry synthetic timestamps chosen to put a forward reach within reach of the join
scope.coins: n/a: the fixtures carry no coin

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

checks.name: price_at_interior_no_lookahead
checks.assumption: price_at returns the last print at-or-before q (side='right'-1); it must never reach forward to a later print
checks.note: 25 sits between print@20 and print@30; correct ref is 2.0. Getting 3.0 would be lookahead.

checks.name: price_at_boundary_inclusive
checks.assumption: an exact-timestamp match is included as at-or-before (side='right' places q after the equal element, -1 lands on it)
checks.note: q==last print picks that print, not nan.

checks.name: price_at_before_first_nan
checks.assumption: a query before every print yields idx -1 -> nan (no price to carry back)

checks.name: after_last_print_masked_nan
checks.assumption: price_at carries the last price forward, but the explicit tq>last_print mask blanks horizons past the last observed print
checks.method: price_at(q=35)==3.0 carried; then tq>last_print(30) guard -> nan
checks.note: carry-forward is real but the mask removes it -> no fabricated future price.

checks.name: entry_horizon_asymmetry
checks.assumption: entry uses searchsorted side='left'-1 (last STRICTLY BEFORE); horizon uses side='left' (first at-or-after t_fill+h*1000). These opposite sides are what make the join causal at both legs.
checks.method: fill exactly on snapshot t=3000 in grid [1000..5000]; entry_idx, horizon_idx(h=1), horizon_idx(h=0) checked vs hand value
checks.note: entry lands strictly before the boundary; horizon lands on the at-or-after boundary; the two legs use opposite searchsorted sides as the code assumes.

checks.name: horizon_out_of_range_invalid
checks.assumption: a horizon target past the last snapshot gives idx==n -> invalid (no future snapshot is invented)

checks.name: vectorized_markout_ref_batch
checks.assumption: the masked reference is monotone-step and never anticipates: [<10]->nan, [10,20)->1, [20,30)->2, ==30->3, [>30]->nan
checks.note: step-function join with no lookahead reproduced vectorized.
